# orionbelt_machine (Data Source)

Look up a machine by name, e.g. one registered by the console or an install script.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "orionbelt_machine" "web" {
  name = "web-1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `hostname` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `is_active` (Boolean)
- `port` (Number)
- `tags` (Map of String)
